evidence.title: GitHub - Greedeks/GTweak: Portable Tool for an Ideal Windows Setup

name: GTweak
summary: Portable Windows tweaking tool that removes bloat, disables telemetry and applies privacy and performance tweaks.
description: A portable Windows utility for debloating and tuning a system. It uninstalls bundled apps and AI assistants (OneDrive, Edge, pre-installed UWP apps, Cortana, Copilot, Recall), disables telemetry, updates and unnecessary services, blocks Microsoft shadow domains via hosts and firewall, and exposes privacy, network, power, UI and maintenance tweaks. It can also run custom scripts with TrustedInstaller privileges, and ships community translations.
contains: portable Windows 10/11 tweak utility in C# and WPF
removes OneDrive, Edge, WebView2, UWP apps, Cortana, Copilot and Recall
disables telemetry, update services, diagnostics and scheduled tasks
blocks Microsoft shadow domains via hosts and firewall
applies privacy, network, power, UI and maintenance tweaks
runs custom .ps1, .cmd, .bat and .reg scripts as TrustedInstaller
